title: Scalar Quantizer Decoder
text: Convert each index value into quantized output value, 2 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Codebook values} sets Codebook values; {Action for out of range index value}, {Source of codebook} and {Codebook and output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Action for out of range index value
params.values: Action for out of range index value Clip (default) | Clip and warn | Error

params.name: Source of codebook
params.values: Source of codebook Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Codebook and output data type
params.values: Codebook and output data type double (default) | Same as input | single | Inherit via back propagation | numeric type
